label: Occam’s razor and infinite regress: uniform prefix discounts force zero hypothesis weight
paraphrase: Suppose a nonnegative whole-hypothesis weight is bounded above by each of its prefix weights, the initial prefix weight is at most one, and each extension has weight at most a fixed fraction q of the previous prefix weight, with 0 ≤ q < 1. The whole-hypothesis weight is zero.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: The zero-weight bridge to e529c42f: an application premise for one actual causal relation giving equal explanatory adequacy of a finite-ancestry account and an infinite-regress account of the same recipients and a defended prior assignment that gives the whole regress class zero weight, with a rule from that probabilistic preference to the deductive premise e529c42f. This theorem is the route to that zero weight: uniformly discounted depth events containing every admitted regress alternative in one prior model force it.
connection_plan.blocker: No uniform discount over every admitted regress alternative is defended for an actual regress, and the corpus has no argument form from a probabilistic preference to a deductive premise (docs/notes/causal-finitism-367.md, Occam section).
